## Overview

This directory contains governance patterns for autonomous AI application development at Gainwell. These patterns establish the foundational infrastructure required to govern AI agents as autonomous actors — defining the Golden Path catalog, the policy and compliance structures, and the evidence trail that make AI-generated output trustworthy, auditable, and compliant.

These patterns are prerequisites for all other patterns in the autonomous AI development stack. No verification infrastructure, no AI agent context integration, and no intent-to-infrastructure pipeline can operate safely without the structures defined here.

[patterns/governance/ai-development/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

Establish the governance mechanisms that:

- Define and manage the Golden Path catalog of pre-approved workload blueprints
- Enforce AI governance policy across all development personas (human-assisted and fully autonomous)
- Define what conformance means for each Golden Path through machine-readable Verification Contracts
- Generate and retain structured compliance evidence at every pipeline run
- Record AI generation provenance for audit traceability

## Implementation Phasing

These patterns align to the phases defined in the [Enterprise Golden Path Strategy](../../../strategy/white-papers/engineering/enterprise-golden-path-strategy.md):

| Phase | Patterns Required | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Phase 1 — Foundation | PTN-GOV-AI-001, PTN-GOV-AI-002, PTN-GOV-AI-003, PTN-GOV-AI-004 | Months 1–6 |
| Phase 2 — Enforcement | PTN-GOV-AI-005 | Months 7–12 |

## Patterns in this Category

| Pattern ID | Name | Purpose | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PTN-GOV-AI-001](./PTN-GOV-AI-001-golden-path-catalog-governance-pattern.md) | **Golden Path Catalog Governance** | Lifecycle for creating, proposing, ARB-approving, versioning, and retiring Golden Paths — the foundational artifact of the autonomous AI program | 1 |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-002](./PTN-GOV-AI-002-ai-governance-policy-pattern.md) | **AI Governance Policy** | Permitted AI agent use cases, prohibited activities, escalation triggers, and audit trail mandates | 1 |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-003](./PTN-GOV-AI-003-verification-contract-pattern.md) | **Verification Contract** | Machine-readable specification defining what conformance means for each Golden Path — the 8-type verification table that gates catalog publication | 1 |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-004](./PTN-GOV-AI-004-compliance-evidence-store-pattern.md) | **Compliance Evidence Store** | Schema, retention policy (3-year minimum for HIPAA/FedRAMP), and reporting model for machine-generated verification evidence | 1 |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-005](./PTN-GOV-AI-005-ai-audit-provenance-pattern.md) | **AI Audit Provenance** | Tagging AI-generated artifacts with model version, context loaded, Golden Path selected, and timestamp for traceable compliance audit trail | 2 |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-006](./PTN-GOV-AI-006-golden-path-compliance-metadata-pattern.md) | **Golden Path Compliance Metadata** | Governance pattern for compliance metadata attached to Golden Path catalog entries | — |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-007](./PTN-GOV-AI-007-dual-system-governance-sync-pattern.md) | **Dual-System Governance Sync** | Synchronize governance state across dual systems for consistent enforcement | — |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-012](./PTN-GOV-AI-012-federated-change-gateway-pattern.md) | **Federated Change Gateway** | Route every AI agent change through a typed approval path based on change type and risk classification | — |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-009](./PTN-GOV-AI-009-portfolio-rationalization-pattern.md) | **Portfolio Rationalization** | Drive merge, split, contain, and retire decisions using five objective thresholds | — |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-010](./PTN-GOV-AI-010-golden-path-citizen-builders-pattern.md) | **Golden Path for Citizen Builders** | Compress multi-standard compliance into a sequenced checklist-driven process with reusable templates for Mid-Tech builders | — |
| [PTN-GOV-AI-011](./PTN-GOV-AI-011-telemetry-to-governance-feedback-pattern.md) | **Telemetry-to-Governance Feedback** | Feed telemetry signals back into governance review to trigger rationalization and lifecycle state changes | — |

## Dependency Graph

```
PTN-GOV-AI-001 (Catalog)
    ├── required by → PTN-GOV-AI-003 (Verification Contract)
    ├── required by → PTN-INFRA-GOV-001 (Conformance Gate)
    ├── required by → PTN-INFRA-GOV-002 (Policy-as-Code)
    ├── required by → PTN-APP-GOV-001 (Fitness Functions)
    └── required by → PTN-TEC-AI-001 (I2I Pipeline)

PTN-GOV-AI-002 (AI Governance Policy)
    └── required by → PTN-TEC-AI-001 (I2I Pipeline)

PTN-GOV-AI-003 (Verification Contract)
    └── required by → PTN-INFRA-GOV-001, PTN-APP-GOV-001, PTN-INFRA-GOV-002

PTN-GOV-AI-004 (Evidence Store)
    └── required by → all verification layers (L1–L4)

PTN-GOV-AI-005 (AI Provenance)
    └── required by → PTN-TEC-AI-001 (I2I Pipeline)
```
